items.exampleEn: Good books can educate and entertain.
items.exampleZh: 好書能教育人，也能娛樂人。

items.exampleEn: Students may not talk during the examination.
items.exampleZh: 考試期間學生不准說話。

items.exampleEn: Food is not allowed in the laboratory.
I can never remember this formula.
items.exampleZh: 我老是記不住這個公式。

items.exampleEn: This compound turns blue in water.
items.exampleZh: 這種化合物遇水會變藍色。

items.exampleEn: The lecture was about birds in winter.
items.exampleZh: 那場演講的主題是冬天的鳥類。

items.exampleEn: We get heat and radiation from the sun.
items.exampleZh: 我們從太陽得到熱和輻射。

items.exampleEn: Many freshmen get lost on their first day.
items.exampleZh: 很多新生第一天都會迷路。

items.sentenceEn: We have a big examination next week.

items.audioEn: Freshmen, please note: the welcome lecture starts at nine in the main hall, and lunch is at noon.
items.audioZh: 新生請注意：歡迎演講九點在大禮堂開始，午餐在中午。
items.questionZh: 歡迎演講在哪裡、幾點開始？
options: In the main hall at noon
In the main hall at nine

items.sentenceEn: The new laboratory has modern machines.
items.sentenceZh: 新實驗室有現代化的機器。

items.sentenceEn: Every freshman gets a map of the school.
items.sentenceZh: 每位新生都會拿到一張學校地圖。

items.stemEn: Water is a ____ made of two different elements.
items.stemZh: 水是由兩種不同元素組成的化合物。

items.stemEn: Use this ____ to find the area of a circle.
items.stemZh: 用這個公式算出圓形的面積。

items.passageEn: My older sister is a freshman at a science university. She says the lectures are much longer than the classes in high school. Her favorite class is chemistry, and she spends three hours a week in the laboratory. Last week, she made a simple compound from two materials and wrote down its formula. In another class, she learned how scientists measure radiation from the sun. Her first examination is next month, so she studies every night. She wants to become a teacher one day.
items.passageZh: 我姊姊是一所理工大學的新生。她說大學的課比高中長很多。她最喜歡的課是化學，每週要在實驗室待三個小時。上星期，她用兩種材料做出一種簡單的化合物，並寫下它的化學式。在另一門課，她學到科學家怎麼測量來自太陽的輻射。她的第一次考試在下個月，所以她每天晚上都在讀書。她希望有一天能當老師。

questions.questionZh: 姊姊每週在實驗室待多久？

items.promptZh: 我昨天聽了一場有趣的演講。
referenceEn: I went to an interesting lecture yesterday.
I listened to an interesting lecture yesterday.
rubricZh: lecture 表示「演講、講課」，可數名詞，例如 go to a lecture 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 這個展覽的目的是教育大眾了解海洋。
referenceEn: The aim of this show is to educate people about the ocean.
This show aims to educate the public about the sea.
rubricZh: 用 educate 表示「教育」（例如 educate people about…）
「目的是」可寫，例如 aims to、the aim of … is to 等
